name: Recognition
overview: Scripture calls believers to act justly and generously, recognizing the rightful needs of others by withholding no good when we have the power to help (Proverbs 3:27). True recognition in the Christian life is not about seeking human applause but about honoring God through sincere deeds done in faithfulness (Matthew 6:1; Matthew 25:21). This recognition is rooted in the person of Christ, the eternal Word who reveals God’s love by giving His only Son for salvation (John 1:1; John 3:16). Furthermore, believers are encouraged to support the weak and embrace the blessing found in giving rather than receiving, reflecting the heart of Jesus’ teaching (Acts 20:35).
